$comment: Contract for the ImportCases server-side command (AD-003, BR-001, BR-002, FR-002). Deployed via the registration console (plugins/OutcomeTesting.Registration) and added to the OutcomeTesting solution via a solution-file import (src/customapis/al_ImportCases). Custom API parameter Type codes: 0=Boolean, 10=String. Counts are returned as strings, matching al_GenerateExport's RowCount, so the whole command set shares one parameter shape.

customApi.name: al_ImportCases
customApi.description: Validates an Intelligent Office extract server-side and imports it (BR-001, BR-002). Logs an al_importbatch, creates a case per valid row, skips references already held so a re-upload is idempotent, and records each rejected row as an al_importexception with its reason (FR-002).

requestParameters.name: FileName
requestParameters.description: Name of the uploaded extract, recorded as the batch source.

requestParameters.name: Csv
requestParameters.description: The raw CSV extract. Sent as text rather than as parsed rows so BR-002 validation is applied server-side and cannot be bypassed.

requestParameters.name: IdempotencyKey
requestParameters.description: Stable key for the intent; a replay returns the same batch.

responseProperties.name: BatchReference
responseProperties.description: Business code of the batch, shown to the user and used to name the validation report.

responseProperties.name: Total
responseProperties.description: Rows read from the extract, excluding the header and the guide row.

responseProperties.name: Duplicates
responseProperties.description: Rows skipped because the IO reference already exists (BR-001).

responseProperties.name: Failed
responseProperties.description: Rows rejected by validation or refused by Dataverse.

responseProperties.name: Report
responseProperties.description: JSON array of rejected and skipped rows for the validation report (FR-002). Empty on a replay.

responseProperties.name: AuditEventId
responseProperties.description: Id of the Audit Event written.
